आपका स्वागत है! मैं आपका स्वास्थ्य साथी हूं

Select Language / भाषा चुनें:

1️⃣ हिंदी (Hindi)
2️⃣ English
3️⃣ मराठी (Marathi)
4️⃣ ગુજરાતી (Gujarati)
5️⃣ বাংলা (Bengali)
6️⃣ தமிழ் (Tamil)

onboarding.name_request:
👤 *Please tell me your name*

Example: Rahul Kumar
onboarding.location_request:
📍 *Your Location*

Provide accurate location (to find nearby hospitals):

📝 Send in format:
`Area/Village, City, State, Pincode`

Example:
`Koh-e-Fiza, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, 462001`

Or share live location via WhatsApp (📎 → Location)
onboarding.service_selection:
Thank you {name}! 🙏

How can I help you?

1️⃣ 💊 *Health Problem* - Tell me symptoms (text/voice)
2️⃣ 👨‍👩‍👧 *Family Care* - Add family members to track
3️⃣ 💉 *Vaccination* - Child vaccine reminders
4️⃣ 🏥 *Nearby Hospital* - Find nearest hospitals
5️⃣ 🌡️ *Environment Alerts* - Weather, AQI, local outbreaks
6️⃣ 💊 *Medicine Info* - Dosage, side effects
7️⃣ ⚙️ *Update Profile* - Change location, name, language

Quick tips:
• Send a voice note to describe symptoms (we'll transcribe it).
• Send a photo of a wound or rash for analysis.
• Share live location (📎 → Location) for nearby services.

💡 Reply with number (1-7) or type MENU/HELP anytime
onboarding.profile_update:
⚙️ *Update Profile*

What would you like to update?

1️⃣ 📍 *Update Location* - Change city, state (if moving)
2️⃣ 👤 *Change Name* - Update your name
3️⃣ 🌐 *Change Language* - Select communication language

💡 Reply with number (1-3)
onboarding.quick_help:
🆘 Jeevo Quick Help

• Type *MENU* to see available services
• Send a voice note — I'll transcribe and help
• Send a photo — I'll analyze images like rashes or wounds
• Share live location (📎 → Location) to find nearby services

When ready, type *MENU* or just describe your problem.
onboarding.vaccination_setup:
💉 *Vaccination Tracking*

Provide child's details:
`Name, Date of Birth`

Example:
`Aarav, 15/06/2024`

I'll send automatic reminders.
